title.value: The Impact of Reversibility on Parallel Pebbling
The Impact of Reversibility on Parallel Pebbling

abstract.value: The (parallel) classical black pebbling game is a helpful abstraction which allows us to analyze the resources (time, space, spacetime, cumulative space) necessary to evaluate a function f with a static data-dependency graph G on a (parallel) computer. In particular, the parallel black pebbling game has been used as a tool to quantify the (in)security of Data-Independent Memory-Hard Functions (iMHFs).
